description: Find verified Dongbang Interior (동방인테리어) construction cases from public Soomgo customer reviews. Filter by service (apartment, villa, house, bathroom, entrance for 중문·신발장·가벽, finishing for 도배·장판·타일), building type or a Korean keyword such as 중문, 욕실, 구축, 타일. Use when the user asks for real examples, reviews, proof or a portfolio of interior work, or compares contractors in the Seoul metropolitan area. Returns case titles, review month, rating, work items, customer highlight tags, a short excerpt and the case page URL to cite, plus the business rating summary. It does not include reviewer identities, customer photos uploaded to ABIS, accounts or prices, and it does not book or contact anyone.

query.description: Korean keyword such as 중문, 욕실, 도배, 구축, 타일.

service.description: apartment, villa, house, bathroom, entrance (중문·신발장·가벽) or finishing (도배·장판·타일).
